final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of prostate tumor tissue, HiSeq 3000 50 bp SE, TopHat (mm9) + HTSeq-count (S4.6.p1, S4.7.p1, DA.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: tumors from 3 representative animals per group (control, exercise, Phellodendron amurense extract) (S2.2.p1, S4.6.p1)
final.sample_exclusion: one exercise mouse died in week 8 (excluded from the study, S2.1.p1); selection rule for the 3 sequenced 'representative' tumors not reported

factors.name: intervention
levels: exercise (single housed, voluntary wheel running, 12 wk)
Phellodendron amurense extract (PhAm/Nexrutine, 600 mg/kg in AIN-93 diet, group housed)

final.primary_estimand: effect of 12-week voluntary wheel running on prostate tumor gene expression, exercise vs control (S2.2.p1); secondary paper contrast PhAm vs control (S2.2.p2)
planned_contrasts: PhAm vs control (S2.2.p2; paper: 176 DEGs, 76 up / 100 down)

blocking_or_covariance.note: independent animals, one tumor each; no batch reported

final.matrix_scale: HTSeq raw read counts per gene (S4.7.p1)
final.paper_method: R package DESeq, group-pairwise differential expression (S4.7.p1)

paper_threshold.adjustment: FDR (method not named; executor applies BH)
